## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `smartsheet-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Generate an API access token

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Smartsheet account at [app.smartsheet.com](https://app.smartsheet.com). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your Account icon in the lower-left corner. -->
3. Select **Personal Settings**.
4. Navigate to the **API Access** tab and select **Generate new access token**.
5. Give the token a descriptive name (for example, `Ballerina Integration`) and select **OK**.
6. <!-- manual: Give the token a descriptive name (for example, Ballerina Integration) and select OK. -->
7. <!-- manual: Copy the generated token immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
